1.  (1)  Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Keanggotaan Mahkamah
Tinggi (Pesuruhjaya Kehakiman) 2018.

  (2)  Perintah ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 27 Mac 2017.

Pelantikan Pesuruhjaya Kehakiman

2.  Orang yang dinamakan dalam Jadual telah dilantik menjadi Pesuruhjaya
Kehakiman bagi tempoh dua tahun berkuat kuasa mulai 27 Mac 2017.

FEDERAL CONSTITUTION

CONSTITUTION OF THE HIGH COURTS (JUDICIAL COMMISSIONERS) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by Clause (1) of Article 122AB of the
Federal Constitution, the Yang di -Pertuan Agong acting on the advice of the
Prime Minister, after consulting the Chief Justice of the Federal Court,  makes the
following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1)  This order may be cited as the Constitution of the High Cour ts
(Judicial Commissioners) Order 2018.

 (2)  This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 27 March 2017.

Appointment of Judicial Commissioners
2.  The persons named in the Schedule are appointed to be Judicial Commissioners
for a period of two years with effect from 27 March 2017.
